title: Set up on pay day with the pay taken as in: the next check-in's large gain is held until answered (decisions X4, X3; confirm_review_1 item 3)
story: Set up Fri 25 Jun 2027 at 08:00, pay day, with the bank at 40,000. The pay of 250,000 is due that day; nothing is saved as not in yet, so the opening holds it. Rent of 80,000 on the 27th (moved later: Mon 28 Jun); Free to spend is 60,000 a month. On Sat 26 Jun at 09:00 the check-in figure is 290,000: 250,000 more than the app had, more than the period's Free to spend, so it is asked about and held [X4]. Before X4 the gain became Free to spend: the headline was 210,000 against a Free to spend of 60,000 a month. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening; the 250,000 gain is held until the person answers, so it is not placed) = 60,000

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: 290,000 is 250,000 more than the 40,000 the app had: more than the period's Free to spend of 60,000.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 290,000 (the figure typed stands while the question waits) = 290,000
